policy.rounding: Rounded outputs must agree exactly, including zero sign. A one-pixel cross-runtime difference is permitted only when BOTH independently checked unrounded values are within ONE ULP of the SAME half integer; both rounded values must equal ECMAScript Math.round of their respective raw values. No generic pixel allowance.
policy.utcInverse: Integral Date TimeClip outputs compare exactly; nonfinite or out-of-profile inverses must reject.
policy.globalInverse: Turning and plateau ranges retain original native inverse values here, while the checked Rust profile rejects global inverse. Explicit flat range branches reject; nonflat branch inverses compare to original two-stop D3.
policy.rawDuplicate: Raw equal adjacent knots, including all-constant domains, are accepted. Distinct raw knots whose transform collapses or overflows still reject even if native D3 computes a value. Reciprocal nice crossing zero rejects. Original native outputs are retained for every rejected profile and unchecked reciprocal input.
policy.signedZero: JSON strings -0, NaN, Infinity and -Infinity preserve IEEE special values; raw source stops retain signed zero. Numerical display-stop comparison treats signed zero as equal; rounded outputs preserve native zero sign.

nativeFindings.twoStopConstant: Always the sole range pair midpoint.
nativeFindings.threePlusConstant: Unclamped below transformed knot uses the first pair midpoint; at/above uses the last pair midpoint. Raw clamp happens before transformed bisect.
nativeFindings.tie: Polymap reverses descending TRANSFORMED knots and range before bisectRight. Negative power reverses raw tie direction; descending raw tie cannot reuse ascending raw selection.
nativeFindings.duplicateEdgeClamp: Whole raw domain clamp changes the selected duplicate edge branch before normalization. Segment clamp alone is not equivalent.
nativeFindings.inverse: Strict range remains invertible despite repeated domain; source-value plateaus are valid outputs.
